notes.type_correctness: All types are strict — PieceType union, Rotation 0|1|2|3, GameAction enum, GameEvent interface all match spec. noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled; non-null assertions (!.) are warnings-only and confined to spots where values are logically guaranteed.
notes.pattern_adherence: Pure-function pattern is consistently followed across all engine modules — every function returns new state, no input mutation detected. PixiJS v8 API used correctly: await app.init, new Text({text, style}), eventMode='static'. Two prefer-const lint errors in test file were the only deviations; fixed.
notes.test_coverage: 158 tests across 6 suites; 96.26% branch coverage against 80% threshold. All spec-required test cases present (board, pieces, rotation, gravity, lineClear, gameState). Minor uncovered branches in rotation.ts:55-57, gravity.ts:104, lineClear.ts:21 — all defensive/edge paths unlikely to regress.
notes.security: Greenfield game engine with no network calls, no user-supplied data evaluated as code, no auth surface. No obvious XSS or injection vectors. The only external I/O is DOM event listeners — all properly cleaned up in destroy() methods. Score docked slightly because dependency audit was not performed.
notes.architectural_alignment: Module boundary enforcement is implemented via both ESLint no-restricted-imports rules and verified manually — engine/ has zero imports from renderer/, input/, or ui/. Fixed-timestep accumulator pattern matches spec §3 exactly. Cell-size formula matches spec exactly. Mobile breakpoint at 768px matches spec.
